+import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react'
+
+export const QUICK_ADD_FIELDS = [
+  {
+    id: 'dueDate',
+    labelKey: 'layout.quickAddSettings.fields.dueDate',
+    defaultMore: false,
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'repeat',
+    labelKey: 'layout.quickAddSettings.fields.repeat',
+    defaultMore: false,
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'priority',
+    labelKey: 'layout.quickAddSettings.fields.priority',
+    defaultMore: false,
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'assignee',
+    labelKey: 'layout.quickAddSettings.fields.assignee',
+    defaultMore: false,
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'labels',
+    labelKey: 'layout.quickAddSettings.fields.labels',
+    defaultMore: false,
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'attachments',
+    labelKey: 'layout.quickAddSettings.fields.attachments',
+    defaultMore: true,
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'notifications',
+    labelKey: 'layout.quickAddSettings.fields.notifications',
+    defaultMore: true,
+  },
+  {
+    id: 'points',
+    labelKey: 'layout.quickAddSettings.fields.points',
+    defaultMore: true,
+  },
+]
+
+const STORAGE_KEY = 'quickAddMoreFields'
+const CHANGE_EVENT = 'donetick:quick-add-fields-changed'
+const DEFAULT_FIELDS = QUICK_ADD_FIELDS.filter(field => field.defaultMore).map(
+  field => field.id,
+)
+let cachedPreference
+
+const readPreference = () => {
+  if (cachedPreference) return cachedPreference
+  try {
+    const stored = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY))
+    cachedPreference = Array.isArray(stored)
+      ? stored.filter(id => QUICK_ADD_FIELDS.some(field => field.id === id))
+      : DEFAULT_FIELDS
+  } catch {
+    cachedPreference = DEFAULT_FIELDS
+  }
+  return cachedPreference
+}
+
+const subscribe = callback => {
+  const onStorage = event => {
+    if (event.key === STORAGE_KEY || event.key === null) {
+      cachedPreference = undefined
+      callback()
+    }
+  }
+  window.addEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, callback)
+  window.addEventListener('storage', onStorage)
+  return () => {
+    window.removeEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, callback)
+    window.removeEventListener('storage', onStorage)
+  }
+}
+
+export const saveQuickAddMoreFields = fields => {
+  cachedPreference = fields
+  localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(cachedPreference))
+  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(CHANGE_EVENT))
+}
+
+export const useQuickAddMoreFields = () =>
+  useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, readPreference, () => DEFAULT_FIELDS)

+import { Box, Switch, Typography } from '@mui/joy'
+import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'
+
+import {
+  QUICK_ADD_FIELDS,
+  saveQuickAddMoreFields,
+  useQuickAddMoreFields,
+} from '../../utils/QuickAddFieldsPreference'
+import SettingsLayout from './SettingsLayout'
+import SettingsSection from './SettingsSection'
+
+const QuickAddSettings = () => {
+  const { t } = useTranslation('settings')
+  const moreFields = useQuickAddMoreFields()
+
+  return (
+    <SettingsLayout title={t('layout.quickAddSettings.title')}>
+      <Box sx={{ maxWidth: 680, pb: 4 }}>
+        <Typography
+          level='body-md'
+          textColor='text.secondary'
+          sx={{ maxWidth: 560, mb: 3, mt: -1, textWrap: 'pretty' }}
+        >
+          {t('layout.quickAddSettings.description')}
+        </Typography>
+        <SettingsSection
+          title={t('layout.quickAddSettings.fieldsTitle')}
+          description={t('layout.quickAddSettings.helper')}
+        >
+          {QUICK_ADD_FIELDS.map(field => {
+            const inMore = moreFields.includes(field.id)
+            const label = t(field.labelKey)
+            const description = t(
+              `layout.quickAddSettings.fieldDescriptions.${field.id}`,
+            )
+            return (
+              <Box
+                key={field.id}
+                sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 2, py: 1 }}
+              >
+                <Box sx={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
+                  <Typography level='title-sm' id={`quick-add-${field.id}`}>
+                    {label}
+                  </Typography>
+                  <Typography level='body-sm' textColor='text.secondary'>
+                    {t(
+                      inMore
+                        ? 'layout.quickAddSettings.inMore'
+                        : 'layout.quickAddSettings.inQuickAdd',
+                    )}
+                    {description ? ` · ${description}` : ''}
+                  </Typography>
+                </Box>
+                <Switch
+                  checked={!inMore}
+                  onChange={event => {
+                    const showInQuickAdd = event.target.checked
+                    saveQuickAddMoreFields(
+                      showInQuickAdd
+                        ? moreFields.filter(id => id !== field.id)
+                        : [...moreFields, field.id],
+                    )
+                  }}
+                  color={!inMore ? 'primary' : 'neutral'}
+                  slotProps={{
+                    input: { 'aria-labelledby': `quick-add-${field.id}` },
+                  }}
+                  sx={{ flexShrink: 0 }}
+                />
+              </Box>
+            )
+          })}
+        </SettingsSection>
+        <Typography level='body-xs' textColor='text.tertiary' sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
+          {t('layout.savedOnDevice')}
+        </Typography>
+      </Box>
+    </SettingsLayout>
+  )
+}
+
+export default QuickAddSettings
